sanskrit:
कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन।
मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि॥
hindi: तुम्हारा अधिकार केवल कर्म करने में है, उसके फलों में कभी नहीं। फल की कामना से कर्म मत करो, और न ही अकर्म में आसक्त हो।
english: You have a right to perform your prescribed duties, but you are not entitled to the fruits of your actions. Never consider yourself the cause of results, and never be attached to inaction.
arjuna_struggle: Why should I fight if I cannot control the outcome?
krishna_answer: Act from duty, not desire. The fruit is not yours to claim.

sanskrit:
योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनञ्जय।
सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते॥
hindi: हे धनंजय, आसक्ति छोड़कर, सफलता और असफलता में समभाव रखते हुए योग में स्थित होकर कर्म करो। यही समत्व योग कहलाता है।
english: Be steadfast in your duty, O Arjuna, abandoning all attachment to success or failure. Such equanimity of mind is called Yoga.
arjuna_struggle: I am afraid of losing and afraid of winning — what should I feel?
krishna_answer: Feel nothing for the outcome. Feel everything for the act itself.

sanskrit:
मात्रास्पर्शास्तु कौन्तेय शीतोष्णसुखदुःखदाः।
आगमापायिनोऽनित्यास्तांस्तितिक्षस्व भारत॥
hindi: हे कुन्तीपुत्र, सर्दी-गर्मी, सुख-दुख — ये सब इन्द्रियों और विषयों के संयोग से उत्पन्न होते हैं। वे आते-जाते रहते हैं, अनित्य हैं। उन्हें सहन करना सीखो।
english: O son of Kunti, the non-permanent appearance of happiness and distress, and their disappearance in due course, are like the appearance and disappearance of winter and summer. They arise from sense perception, and one must learn to tolerate them.
arjuna_struggle: I am overwhelmed by grief.
krishna_answer: This too shall pass. Pleasure and pain are seasonal — neither defines you.

sanskrit:
न जायते म्रियते वा कदाचिन्नायं भूत्वा भविता वा न भूयः।
अजो नित्यः शाश्वतोऽयं पुराणो न हन्यते हन्यमाने शरीरे॥
hindi: यह आत्मा न कभी जन्म लेती है और न मरती है। यह न कभी थी और न नहीं होगी। यह अजन्मा, नित्य, शाश्वत और पुरातन है। शरीर के नष्ट होने पर भी यह नष्ट नहीं होती।
english: The soul is never born, nor does it ever die. It has not come into being, does not come into being, and will not come into being. It is unborn, eternal, ever-existing, and primeval. It is not slain when the body is slain.
arjuna_struggle: I am afraid of what death means.
krishna_answer: You cannot kill what was never born. You are older than this battlefield.

sanskrit:
नैनं छिन्दन्ति शस्त्राणि नैनं दहति पावकः।
न चैनं क्लेदयन्त्यापो न शोषयति मारुतः॥
hindi: इस आत्मा को शस्त्र नहीं काट सकते, अग्नि नहीं जला सकती, जल नहीं भिगो सकता और वायु नहीं सुखा सकती।
english: The soul can never be cut to pieces by any weapon, nor burned by fire, nor moistened by water, nor withered by the wind.
arjuna_struggle: I fear the destruction of everything I love.
krishna_answer: The essence of a person cannot be destroyed. Fear guards what cannot be harmed.

sanskrit:
ध्यायतो विषयान्पुंसः सङ्गस्तेषूपजायते।
सङ्गात्सञ्जायते कामः कामात्क्रोधोऽभिजायते॥
hindi: विषयों का चिंतन करने वाले पुरुष की उनमें आसक्ति हो जाती है। आसक्ति से कामना उत्पन्न होती है, और कामना से क्रोध उत्पन्न होता है।
english: While contemplating the objects of the senses, a person develops attachment for them, and from such attachment lust develops, and from lust anger arises.
arjuna_struggle: I cannot stop my mind from craving.
krishna_answer: Every craving begins with a single thought. Guard the first step.

sanskrit:
तस्मादसक्तः सततं कार्यं कर्म समाचर।
असक्तो ह्याचरन्कर्म परमाप्नोति पूरुषः॥
hindi: इसलिए आसक्ति रहित होकर सदा कर्तव्य कर्म करते रहो। आसक्ति रहित होकर कर्म करने वाला पुरुष परम को प्राप्त होता है।
english: Therefore, always perform your duty without attachment, for by performing actions without attachment, one attains the Supreme.
arjuna_struggle: What is the point of acting if I feel nothing?
krishna_answer: Detachment is not numbness — it is freedom. Act fully, cling to nothing.

sanskrit:
प्रकृतेः क्रियमाणानि गुणैः कर्माणि सर्वशः।
अहङ्कारविमूढात्मा कर्ताहमिति मन्यते॥
hindi: वास्तव में सभी कर्म प्रकृति के गुणों द्वारा किए जाते हैं। किन्तु अहंकार से मोहित व्यक्ति मानता है कि मैं ही कर्ता हूँ।
english: The spirit soul bewildered by the influence of false ego thinks himself the doer of activities that are in actuality carried out by the three modes of material nature.
arjuna_struggle: I carry the weight of what I have done.
krishna_answer: The 'I' that acts is smaller than you think. You are the witness, not the doer.

sanskrit:
यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत।
अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम्॥
hindi: हे भारत, जब-जब धर्म की हानि और अधर्म की वृद्धि होती है, तब-तब मैं अपने आप को प्रकट करता हूँ।
english: Whenever there is a decline in righteousness and an increase in unrighteousness, O Arjuna, at that time I manifest myself.
arjuna_struggle: The world feels broken and unjust.
krishna_answer: The world is never abandoned. Where dharma falls, it is restored.

sanskrit:
न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते।
तत्स्वयं योगसंसिद्धः कालेनात्मनि विन्दति॥
hindi: इस संसार में ज्ञान के समान पवित्र करने वाला कोई साधन नहीं है। जो योग में सिद्ध हो जाता है वह स्वयं कालक्रम से आत्मा में इसे पा लेता है।
english: In this world, there is nothing as purifying as knowledge. One who is perfected in yoga finds this within the self in due time.
arjuna_struggle: I do not know enough to act rightly.
krishna_answer: Knowledge is not gathered — it is uncovered. Practice reveals it from within.

sanskrit:
ये हि संस्पर्शजा भोगा दुःखयोनय एव ते।
आद्यन्तवन्तः कौन्तेय न तेषु रमते बुधः॥
hindi: हे कुन्तीपुत्र, जो भोग इन्द्रिय और विषय के संयोग से उत्पन्न होते हैं, वे दुख के ही कारण हैं। उनका आदि और अन्त है। बुद्धिमान उनमें आनंद नहीं मानता।
english: The pleasures that arise from contact with sense objects are sources of misery. They have a beginning and an end, O son of Kunti, and the wise person does not delight in them.
arjuna_struggle: I keep chasing pleasure and finding emptiness.
krishna_answer: Every pleasure that needs a source is already carrying its own end.

sanskrit:
उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत्।
आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः॥
hindi: अपने द्वारा अपना उद्धार करो, अपने को नीचे मत गिरने दो। क्योंकि आत्मा स्वयं अपना मित्र है और आत्मा ही अपना शत्रु है।
english: Elevate yourself through the power of your mind, and not degrade yourself, for the mind can be the ally of the self and also the enemy of the self.
arjuna_struggle: I am my own worst enemy.
krishna_answer: Then become your own closest friend. No one else can cross that line for you.

sanskrit:
बन्धुरात्मात्मनस्तस्य येनात्मैवात्मना जितः।
अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्तेतात्मैव शत्रुवत्॥
hindi: जिसने अपने मन को जीत लिया है, उसके लिए वह मन ही उसका मित्र है। और जिसने अपने मन को नहीं जीता, उसके लिए वह मन शत्रु की भाँति कार्य करता है।
english: For one who has conquered the mind, the mind is the best of friends. But for one who has failed to do so, his very mind will be the greatest enemy.
arjuna_struggle: My own thoughts betray me.
krishna_answer: The untrained mind is enemy enough. But it can be trained.

sanskrit:
युक्ताहारविहारस्य युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु।
युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा॥
hindi: जो खाने-पीने, विहार करने, कर्म में, सोने-जागने में संयमित है — उसके लिए योग सभी दुखों का नाश करने वाला बन जाता है।
english: He who is regulated in his habits of eating, sleeping, recreation, and work can mitigate all material pains by practicing Yoga.
arjuna_struggle: I keep failing at the basics — sleep, food, discipline.
krishna_answer: The battlefield of the body is won through regularity, not heroics. Start small.

sanskrit:
यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता।
योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युञ्जतो योगमात्मनः॥
hindi: जिस प्रकार वायुरहित स्थान में दीपक की लौ नहीं हिलती, उसी उपमा को ध्यान में लीन योगी के वश में किए गए चित्त के लिए स्मरण किया जाता है।
english: Just as a lamp in a windless place does not flicker, so the disciplined mind of a yogi does not waver — this is the image given.
arjuna_struggle: My mind won't be still.
krishna_answer: A flame in a still room. That is the goal. Find the still room first.

sanskrit:
चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद्दृढम्।
तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये वायोरिव सुदुष्करम्॥
hindi: हे कृष्ण, यह मन बड़ा चञ्चल, उद्दण्ड, बलशाली और दृढ़ है। इसे वश में करना मुझे वायु को रोकने के समान अत्यंत कठिन लगता है।
english: The mind is restless, turbulent, obstinate, and very strong, O Krishna, and to subdue it, I think, is more difficult than controlling the wind.
arjuna_struggle: My mind is impossible to control.
krishna_answer: Arjuna voiced this too. It is the oldest complaint. And the answer is still: abhyasa.

sanskrit:
अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते।
असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः॥
hindi: हे कुन्तीपुत्र, निःसंदेह मन को अभ्यास और वैराग्य से वश में किया जा सकता है। बिना संयम के योग प्राप्त करना कठिन है, यह मेरा मत है।
english: O son of Kunti, it is undoubtedly very difficult to curb the restless mind, but it is possible by suitable practice and by detachment.
arjuna_struggle: Is discipline even possible for someone like me?
krishna_answer: Through practice and detachment. These two words hold the entire path.

sanskrit:
पार्थ नैवेह नामुत्र विनाशस्तस्य विद्यते।
न हि कल्याणकृत्कश्चिद्दुर्गतिं तात गच्छति॥
hindi: हे पार्थ, न इस लोक में और न परलोक में ऐसे व्यक्ति का नाश होता है। हे तात, कल्याण का मार्ग अपनाने वाला व्यक्ति कभी दुर्गति को नहीं जाता।
english: O Partha, a transcendentalist engaged in auspicious activities does not meet with destruction either in this world or in the spiritual world. One who does good, My friend, is never overcome by evil.
arjuna_struggle: What if I fail and all my effort is wasted?
krishna_answer: No sincere effort is ever lost. The path remembers every step.

sanskrit:
रसोऽहमप्सु कौन्तेय प्रभास्मि शशिसूर्ययोः।
प्रणवः सर्ववेदेषु शब्दः खे पौरुषं नृषु॥
hindi: हे कुन्तीपुत्र, मैं जल में रस हूँ, सूर्य और चन्द्रमा में प्रकाश हूँ, समस्त वेदों में ओंकार हूँ, आकाश में शब्द हूँ, और मनुष्यों में पुरुषत्व हूँ।
english: O son of Kunti, I am the taste of water, the light of the sun and the moon, the syllable Om in the Vedic mantras, the sound in ether, and the ability in man.
arjuna_struggle: I cannot see or feel the divine anywhere.
krishna_answer: You are drinking it. You are breathing it. The divine is not elsewhere.

sanskrit:
अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते।
तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम्॥
hindi: जो लोग अनन्य भक्ति से मेरा चिंतन करते हुए मेरी उपासना करते हैं, उन नित्य-युक्त भक्तों का योगक्षेम मैं स्वयं वहन करता हूँ।
english: For those who worship Me with devotion, meditating on My transcendental form, I carry what they lack and preserve what they have.
arjuna_struggle: I am alone in this.
krishna_answer: You are not. What you lack will be given. What you have will be kept.

sanskrit:
तेषां सततयुक्तानां भजतां प्रीतिपूर्वकम्।
ददामि बुद्धियोगं तं येन मामुपयान्ति ते॥
hindi: उन निरंतर मुझमें लगे रहने वाले और प्रेमपूर्वक भजन करने वाले भक्तों को मैं वह बुद्धियोग देता हूँ जिससे वे मुझे प्राप्त होते हैं।
english: To those who are constantly devoted and worship Me with love, I give the understanding by which they can come to Me.
arjuna_struggle: I do not know the way forward.
krishna_answer: The path is given to those who show up consistently. Clarity follows commitment.

sanskrit:
तस्मात्त्वमुत्तिष्ठ यशो लभस्व जित्वा शत्रून्भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यं समृद्धम्।
मयैवैते निहताः पूर्वमेव निमित्तमात्रं भव सव्यसाचिन्॥
hindi: इसलिए उठो और यश प्राप्त करो। शत्रुओं को जीतकर समृद्ध राज्य भोगो। ये सब पहले से ही मेरे द्वारा नियत हैं। हे सव्यसाचिन, तुम केवल निमित्त मात्र बनो।
english: Therefore, arise and attain glory. Conquer your enemies and enjoy a flourishing kingdom. They have already been destroyed by Me; you are merely the instrument.
arjuna_struggle: The burden feels too heavy for me to carry.
krishna_answer: You do not carry it alone. You are the instrument, not the source.

sanskrit:
अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च।
निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी॥
hindi: जो समस्त प्राणियों से द्वेष नहीं करता, मित्रभाव और करुणा रखता है, ममता और अहंकार से रहित है, सुख-दुख में समान रहता है, और क्षमाशील है।
english: One who is not envious but is a kind friend to all living entities, who does not think himself a proprietor, who is free from false ego and equal in distress and happiness, who is forgiving.
arjuna_struggle: People have wronged me. I carry anger.
krishna_answer: The devotee has no enemies — only beings in varying degrees of confusion.

sanskrit:
अमानित्वमदम्भित्वमहिंसा क्षान्तिरार्जवम्।
आचार्योपासनं शौचं स्थैर्यमात्मविनिग्रहः॥
hindi: अभिमानहीनता, दम्भहीनता, अहिंसा, क्षमाशीलता, सरलता, गुरु की सेवा, पवित्रता, स्थिरता और आत्म-संयम।
english: Humility, absence of pride, nonviolence, tolerance, simplicity, approaching a genuine teacher, cleanliness, steadiness, and self-control.
arjuna_struggle: What qualities should I cultivate?
krishna_answer: These eight. They are not achievements — they are the direction to walk.

sanskrit:
सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसम्भवाः।
निबध्नन्ति महाबाहो देहे देहिनमव्ययम्॥
hindi: हे महाबाहो, प्रकृति से उत्पन्न सत्त्व, रज और तम — ये तीन गुण अविनाशी आत्मा को शरीर में बाँधते हैं।
english: Material nature consists of the three qualities — goodness, passion, and ignorance. When the living entity contacts these, he is conditioned by them.
arjuna_struggle: Why do I sometimes act against my own values?
krishna_answer: The three gunas pull you in different directions. Observe which one has the floor.

sanskrit:
निर्मानमोहा जितसङ्गदोषा अध्यात्मनित्या विनिवृत्तकामाः।
द्वन्द्वैर्विमुक्ताः सुखदुःखसञ्ज्ञैर्गच्छन्त्यमूढाः पदमव्ययम्॥
hindi: जो मान और मोह से मुक्त हैं, जिन्होंने आसक्ति के दोष जीत लिए हैं, जो नित्य आत्मज्ञान में स्थित हैं, जिनकी कामनाएँ शान्त हो गई हैं और जो सुख-दुख के द्वन्द्वों से मुक्त हैं — वे अव्यय पद को प्राप्त करते हैं।
english: Those who are free from false prestige, illusion, and false association, who understand the eternal, who are done with material lust, who are freed from the dualities of happiness and distress, and who are not bewildered — they attain that eternal kingdom.
arjuna_struggle: What does the end of the path look like?
krishna_answer: Freedom from the need for things to be different than they are.

sanskrit:
अभयं सत्त्वसंशुद्धिर्ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः।
दानं दमश्च यज्ञश्च स्वाध्यायस्तप आर्जवम्॥
hindi: निर्भयता, अन्तःकरण की शुद्धि, ज्ञानयोग में दृढ़ स्थिति, दान, इन्द्रिय-संयम, यज्ञ, स्वाध्याय, तप और सरलता।
english: Fearlessness, purification of one's existence, cultivation of spiritual knowledge, charity, self-control, sacrifice, study of the Vedas, austerity, and simplicity.
arjuna_struggle: What does a good person actually do?
krishna_answer: Start with fearlessness. Everything else builds from there.

sanskrit:
सत्त्वानुरूपा सर्वस्य श्रद्धा भवति भारत।
श्रद्धामयोऽयं पुरुषो यो यच्छ्रद्धः स एव सः॥
hindi: हे भारत, प्रत्येक प्राणी की श्रद्धा उसके स्वभाव के अनुसार होती है। यह पुरुष श्रद्धामय है — जैसी जिसकी श्रद्धा, वैसा वही है।
english: O son of Bharata, according to one's existence under the various modes of nature, one evolves a particular kind of faith. The living being is said to be of a particular faith according to the modes he has acquired.
arjuna_struggle: What defines me?
krishna_answer: You are what you believe deeply, not what you say you believe.

sanskrit:
सर्वभूतेषु येनैकं भावमव्ययमीक्षते।
अविभक्तं विभक्तेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि सात्त्विकम्॥
hindi: जिस ज्ञान से सभी विभक्त प्राणियों में एक अव्यय भाव को देखा जाता है, उस अविभाजित को विभाजित में — उसे सात्त्विक ज्ञान जानो।
english: That knowledge by which one undivided spiritual nature is seen in all living entities, though they are divided into innumerable forms, you should understand to be in the mode of goodness.
arjuna_struggle: I feel separate from everyone and everything.
krishna_answer: The separateness is a story. Beneath it, one nature runs through everything.

sanskrit:
स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धिं लभते नरः।
स्वकर्मनिरतः सिद्धिं यथा विन्दति तच्छृणु॥
hindi: अपने-अपने कर्म में लगा हुआ मनुष्य सिद्धि को प्राप्त होता है। अपने कर्म में लगे हुए मनुष्य को किस प्रकार सिद्धि मिलती है, यह सुनो।
english: By following his qualities of work, every man can become perfect. Now please hear from Me how this can be done.
arjuna_struggle: Should I be doing something else entirely?
krishna_answer: Your own path, imperfectly walked, is greater than another's path perfectly copied.

sanskrit:
सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज।
अहं त्वां सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः॥
hindi: सभी धर्मों को छोड़कर केवल मेरी शरण में आ जाओ। मैं तुम्हें सभी पापों से मुक्त कर दूँगा। चिंता मत करो।
english: Abandon all varieties of religion and just surrender to Me. I shall deliver you from all sinful reaction, do not fear.
arjuna_struggle: I have failed so many times. I am beyond help.
krishna_answer: None of that matters. Come as you are.

sanskrit:
यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः।
तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम॥
hindi: जहाँ योगेश्वर श्रीकृष्ण हैं और जहाँ धनुर्धारी पार्थ हैं — वहाँ श्री, विजय, विभूति और अटल नीति है, ऐसा मेरा मत है।
english: Wherever there is Krishna, the master of all mystics, and wherever there is Arjuna, the supreme archer, there will certainly be opulence, victory, extraordinary power, and morality.
arjuna_struggle: Will any of this effort actually succeed?
krishna_answer: Where wisdom and courage meet, victory follows as naturally as dawn follows night.

sanskrit:
यं हि न व्यथयन्त्येते पुरुषं पुरुषर्षभ।
समदुःखसुखं धीरं सोऽमृतत्वाय कल्पते॥
hindi: हे पुरुषश्रेष्ठ, जो पुरुष इन सभी से व्यथित नहीं होता और जो सुख-दुख में समान रहता है, वह धीर पुरुष अमरत्व के लिए योग्य हो जाता है।
english: O best among men, the person who is not disturbed by happiness and distress and is steady in both is certainly eligible for liberation.
arjuna_struggle: How do I stop being tossed around by life?
krishna_answer: The same water that rocks a small boat barely moves a ship. Become the ship.

sanskrit:
आपूर्यमाणमचलप्रतिष्ठं समुद्रमापः प्रविशन्ति यद्वत्।
तद्वत्कामा यं प्रविशन्ति सर्वे स शान्तिमाप्नोति न कामकामी॥
hindi: जैसे अचल-प्रतिष्ठित, परिपूर्ण समुद्र में नाना नदियों का जल आकर मिल जाता है, उसी प्रकार जिस मनुष्य में सभी कामनाएँ विलीन हो जाती हैं — वह शान्ति को प्राप्त होता है, न कि कामना करने वाला।
english: One who is not disturbed in mind even amidst the threefold miseries or elated when there is happiness, and who is free from attachment, fear, and anger, is called a sage of steady mind.
arjuna_struggle: I am always wanting more.
krishna_answer: The ocean does not swell when rivers pour in. Become ocean-like in your wanting.

sanskrit:
श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात्।
स्वधर्मे निधनं श्रेयः परधर्मो भयावहः॥
hindi: गुणरहित स्वधर्म, अच्छी तरह से पालन किए गए परधर्म से श्रेष्ठ है। अपने धर्म में मृत्यु भी कल्याणकारी है, परधर्म भयावह है।
english: It is far better to discharge one's prescribed duties, even though faultily, than another's duties perfectly. It is better to die in the discharge of one's own duty than to follow the path of another.
arjuna_struggle: I keep comparing myself to others who seem more accomplished.
krishna_answer: Your imperfect path is more sacred than their perfect one. Walk your own road.

sanskrit:
कर्मण्यकर्म यः पश्येदकर्मणि च कर्म यः।
स बुद्धिमान्मनुष्येषु स युक्तः कृत्स्नकर्मकृत्॥
hindi: जो कर्म में अकर्म और अकर्म में कर्म देखता है, वही मनुष्यों में बुद्धिमान है, वही योगी है और सभी कर्मों का करने वाला है।
english: One who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is intelligent among men, and is in the transcendental position, although engaged in all sorts of activities.
arjuna_struggle: I do not understand the difference between doing and not-doing.
krishna_answer: The deepest action leaves no residue. The deepest stillness contains all motion.

sanskrit:
श्रद्धावान्लभते ज्ञानं तत्परः संयतेन्द्रियः।
ज्ञानं लब्ध्वा परां शान्तिमचिरेणाधिगच्छति॥
hindi: श्रद्धावान, तत्पर और इन्द्रियों को संयत करने वाला व्यक्ति ज्ञान को प्राप्त करता है। ज्ञान प्राप्त कर लेने के बाद वह शीघ्र परम शान्ति को प्राप्त होता है।
english: A faithful man who is dedicated to transcendental knowledge and who subdues his senses quickly attains the supreme peace.
arjuna_struggle: How long will this take?
krishna_answer: Faster than you think, once faith and self-control arrive together.

sanskrit:
कायेन मनसा बुद्ध्या केवलैरिन्द्रियैरपि।
योगिनः कर्म कुर्वन्ति सङ्गं त्यक्त्वात्मशुद्धये॥
hindi: योगी लोग शरीर, मन, बुद्धि और केवल इन्द्रियों से भी आसक्ति छोड़कर आत्मशुद्धि के लिए कर्म करते हैं।
english: The yogis, abandoning attachment, act with body, mind, intelligence, and even with the senses, only for the purpose of purification.
arjuna_struggle: My motivations feel mixed and impure.
krishna_answer: Act for purification, not perfection. The act cleanses the actor.

sanskrit:
यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम्।
ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत्॥
hindi: जहाँ-जहाँ यह चञ्चल और अस्थिर मन भटकता है, वहाँ-वहाँ से इसे रोककर इसे आत्मा में ही वश में करो।
english: Wherever the mind wanders, due to its flickering and unsteady nature, one must certainly withdraw it and bring it back under the control of the self.
arjuna_struggle: I lose focus and then feel guilty about losing focus.
krishna_answer: Return. That is the entire practice — return, again and again, without drama.

sanskrit:
बहूनां जन्मनामन्ते ज्ञानवान्मां प्रपद्यते।
वासुदेवः सर्वमिति स महात्मा सुदुर्लभः॥
hindi: अनेक जन्मों के अंत में ज्ञानी पुरुष 'वासुदेव ही सब कुछ है' — इस प्रकार मुझे प्राप्त होता है। ऐसा महात्मा अत्यन्त दुर्लभ है।
english: After many births and deaths, he who is actually in knowledge surrenders unto Me, knowing Me to be the cause of all causes and all that is. Such a great soul is very rare.
arjuna_struggle: I feel like I am starting over again.
krishna_answer: Every life accumulates. Nothing is truly starting over.

sanskrit:
तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च।
मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्मामेवैष्यस्यसंशयम्॥
hindi: इसलिए, सभी समयों में मेरा स्मरण करो और युद्ध भी करो। मुझमें मन और बुद्धि अर्पण करके निःसंदेह तुम मुझे ही प्राप्त होगे।
english: Therefore, Arjuna, always think of Me and fight. With your mind and intelligence fixed on Me, you will attain Me without doubt.
arjuna_struggle: I forget everything when life gets difficult.
krishna_answer: Remember and act simultaneously. The two are not separate.

sanskrit:
यत्करोषि यदश्नासि यज्जुहोषि ददासि यत्।
यत्तपस्यसि कौन्तेय तत्कुरुष्व मदर्पणम्॥
hindi: हे कुन्तीपुत्र, तुम जो कुछ करते हो, जो खाते हो, जो यज्ञ करते हो, जो दान देते हो, जो तप करते हो — वह सब मुझे अर्पण करो।
english: O son of Kunti, all that you do, all that you eat, all that you offer and give away, as well as all austerities that you may perform, should be done as an offering to Me.
arjuna_struggle: Nothing I do feels meaningful.
krishna_answer: Dedicate the act to something larger. The meaning follows the offering.

sanskrit:
अहमात्मा गुडाकेश सर्वभूताशयस्थितः।
अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च॥
hindi: हे गुडाकेश, मैं सभी प्राणियों के हृदय में स्थित आत्मा हूँ। मैं ही सभी प्राणियों का आदि, मध्य और अन्त हूँ।
english: I am the Self, O Gudakesha, seated in the hearts of all creatures. I am the beginning, the middle, and the end of all beings.
arjuna_struggle: I feel hollow inside.
krishna_answer: That which you feel inside is not hollow — it is vast.

sanskrit:
पुरुषः प्रकृतिस्थो हि भुङ्क्ते प्रकृतिजान्गुणान्।
कारणं गुणसङ्गोऽस्य सदसद्योनिजन्मसु॥
hindi: प्रकृति में स्थित पुरुष प्रकृति से उत्पन्न गुणों को भोगता है। इन गुणों का संग ही अच्छी और बुरी योनियों में जन्म का कारण है।
english: The living entity in material nature thus follows the ways of life, enjoying the three modes of nature. This is due to his association with that material nature. Thus he meets with good and evil among various species.
arjuna_struggle: Why do I keep repeating the same patterns?
krishna_answer: You are drawn to what you have been close to. Change the closeness, change the pattern.

sanskrit:
मां च योऽव्यभिचारेण भक्तियोगेन सेवते।
स गुणान्समतीत्यैतान्ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते॥
hindi: जो मेरी अव्यभिचारिणी भक्तियोग से सेवा करता है, वह इन तीनों गुणों को पार कर ब्रह्म होने के लिए योग्य हो जाता है।
english: One who engages in full devotional service, unfailing in all circumstances, at once transcends the modes of material nature and thus comes to the level of Brahman.
arjuna_struggle: The circumstances around me feel impossible.
krishna_answer: Transcendence is not about the circumstances — it is available in all of them.

sanskrit:
सर्वस्य चाहं हृदि सन्निविष्टो मत्तः स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनं च।
वेदैश्च सर्वैरहमेव वेद्यो वेदान्तकृद्वेदविदेव चाहम्॥
hindi: मैं सभी के हृदय में निहित हूँ। स्मृति, ज्ञान और विस्मरण मुझसे ही होते हैं। समस्त वेदों से जानने योग्य मैं ही हूँ, वेदान्त का कर्ता और वेद को जानने वाला भी मैं ही हूँ।
english: I am seated in everyone's heart, and from Me come remembrance, knowledge, and forgetfulness. By all the Vedas, I am to be known; indeed I am the compiler of Vedanta, and I am the knower of the Vedas.
arjuna_struggle: I cannot find guidance anywhere.
krishna_answer: It comes from within. The one you are seeking is closer than thought.

sanskrit:
त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः।
कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत्त्रयं त्यजेत्॥
hindi: काम, क्रोध और लोभ — ये तीन आत्मा को नष्ट करने वाले नरक के द्वार हैं। इसलिए इन तीनों को त्यागना चाहिए।
english: There are three gates leading to the hell of self-destruction: lust, anger, and greed. Every sane man should give these up, for they lead to the degradation of the soul.
arjuna_struggle: I know my weaknesses but cannot stop.
krishna_answer: Name them clearly. Lust. Anger. Greed. They lose power when named.

sanskrit:
मनःप्रसादः सौम्यत्वं मौनमात्मविनिग्रहः।
भावसंशुद्धिरित्येतत्तपो मानसमुच्यते॥
hindi: मन की प्रसन्नता, सौम्यता, मौन, आत्म-संयम और भावों की शुद्धि — इन्हें मानसिक तप कहा जाता है।
english: And serenity, simplicity, gravity, self-control, and purification of one's existence are the austerities of the mind.
arjuna_struggle: How do I discipline my mind, not just my body?
krishna_answer: Serenity. Silence. Gravity. Purity. These are not moods — they are practices.

sanskrit:
यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यं कार्यमेव तत्।
यज्ञो दानं तपश्चैव पावनानि मनीषिणाम्॥
hindi: यज्ञ, दान और तप के कर्म त्याज्य नहीं हैं, उन्हें अवश्य करना चाहिए। यज्ञ, दान और तप बुद्धिमानों को पवित्र करते हैं।
english: Acts of sacrifice, charity, and penance are not to be given up; they must be performed. Indeed, sacrifice, charity, and penance purify even the great souls.
arjuna_struggle: Maybe I should just give it all up.
krishna_answer: Do not abandon the practice — abandon the attachment to its results.

sanskrit:
यस्य नाहङ्कृतो भावो बुद्धिर्यस्य न लिप्यते।
हत्वाऽपि स इमाँल्लोकान्न हन्ति न निबध्यते॥
hindi: जिसके अन्तःकरण में अहंकार का भाव नहीं है और जिसकी बुद्धि लिप्त नहीं होती, वह इन सभी प्राणियों को मारकर भी न मारता है और न बंधन में पड़ता है।
english: One who is not motivated by false ego, whose intelligence is not entangled, though he kills men in this world, does not kill. Nor is he bound by his actions.
arjuna_struggle: I feel responsible for everything that goes wrong.
krishna_answer: The ego claims credit for both the action and the outcome. Neither is truly yours.

sanskrit:
अज्ञश्चाश्रद्दधानश्च संशयात्मा विनश्यति।
नायं लोकोऽस्ति न परो न सुखं संशयात्मनः॥
hindi: जो अज्ञानी, श्रद्धारहित और संशयवाला है, वह नष्ट हो जाता है। संशयवाले व्यक्ति के लिए न यह लोक है, न परलोक और न सुख।
english: But ignorant and faithless persons who doubt the revealed scriptures do not attain God consciousness; they fall down. For the doubting soul there is happiness neither in this world nor in the next.
arjuna_struggle: I doubt everything, including myself.
krishna_answer: Doubt that questions is useful. Doubt that paralyses is the real enemy.

sanskrit:
तपस्विभ्योऽधिको योगी ज्ञानिभ्योऽपि मतोऽधिकः।
कर्मिभ्यश्चाधिको योगी तस्माद्योगी भवार्जुन॥
hindi: योगी तपस्वियों से श्रेष्ठ है, ज्ञानियों से भी श्रेष्ठ माना जाता है और कर्मियों से भी श्रेष्ठ है। इसलिए हे अर्जुन, तुम योगी बनो।
english: A yogi is greater than the ascetic, greater than the empiricist, and greater than the fruitive worker. Therefore, O Arjuna, in all circumstances, be a yogi.
arjuna_struggle: What should I actually strive to become?
krishna_answer: A yogi. Not a scholar. Not a monk. Someone who acts with inner union.

sanskrit:
प्रजहाति यदा कामान्सर्वान्पार्थ मनोगतान्।
आत्मन्येवात्मना तुष्टः स्थितप्रज्ञस्तदोच्यते॥
hindi: हे पार्थ, जब मनुष्य मन में स्थित सभी कामनाओं को त्याग देता है और आत्मा में ही आत्मा से संतुष्ट रहता है, तब उसे स्थितप्रज्ञ कहते हैं।
english: O Partha, when a man gives up all varieties of desire that arise in the mind, and when his mind, satisfied in the self alone, is content in itself — then he is said to be in pure transcendental consciousness.
arjuna_struggle: What does real peace of mind look like?
krishna_answer: Contentment that needs no conditions. Not happiness — peace.

sanskrit:
इहैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं पश्याद्य सचराचरम्।
मम देहे गुडाकेश यच्चान्यद्द्रष्टुमिच्छसि॥
hindi: हे गुडाकेश, आज मेरे इस शरीर में एक स्थान पर स्थित समस्त चराचर जगत को देखो और जो कुछ भी तुम देखना चाहते हो, वह देखो।
english: O Arjuna, whatever you wish to see, behold at once in this body of Mine! This universal form can show you whatever you now desire to see and whatever you may want to see in the future.
arjuna_struggle: I cannot see the bigger picture.
krishna_answer: Sometimes the bigger picture must be shown rather than understood.

sanskrit:
मय्येव मन आधत्स्व मयि बुद्धिं निवेशय।
निवसिष्यसि मय्येव अत ऊर्ध्वं न संशयः॥
hindi: मुझ में ही मन लगाओ, मुझ में ही बुद्धि को स्थापित करो। इसके बाद तुम निःसंदेह मुझ में ही वास करोगे।
english: Just fix your mind upon Me, and engage all your intelligence in Me. Thus you will live in Me always, without a doubt.
arjuna_struggle: My mind is scattered across a hundred worries.
krishna_answer: One anchor. Place your mind there. The rest settles.

sanskrit:
क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि सर्वक्षेत्रेषु भारत।
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्ज्ञानं यत्तज्ज्ञानं मतं मम॥
hindi: हे भारत, तुम मुझे सभी क्षेत्रों में क्षेत्रज्ञ जानो। क्षेत्र और क्षेत्रज्ञ को जानना — यही वास्तविक ज्ञान है, यह मेरा मत है।
english: O scion of Bharata, you should understand that I am also the knower in all bodies, and to understand this body and its knower is called knowledge.
arjuna_struggle: Who am I beneath all these roles?
krishna_answer: You are the one who observes. The body is the field. You are the knower of the field.
